column1: Bobby Witt Jr. leads the slate with a strong hit probability and excellent recent form, making him a reliable choice at home against Parker Messick, who has allowed elevated hit rates lately. Bo Bichette also offers steady contact skills and benefits from a favorable matchup, though his recent production has dipped. Drake Baldwin and Jeremy Pena are both in good lineup spots with platoon advantages, but Witt’s consistency and matchup set him apart for Beat The Streak players today.
